game.name: Roblox: Grace
game.rules:
# General Rules:

- FPS Unlockers are allowed in runs but you can only set them to the ROBLOX given settings (60 FPS, 120, 144, and 240.)
- Speedrun Timer (found within in-game settings) is **mandatory** and **must be visible at all times**.
- Fonts are allowed in runs as long as the text is readable and can be verified.
- Exploiting is **obviously** **restricted** from runs.
- For multiplayer runs, only 1 POV is needed.
- Game audio must be loud enough so that it can be heard, Background music is fine as long as it doesn't override the game audio
- Runs must be high quality (around 720p) and the speedrun timer must be legible
- Video must start before the lever room opening begins (when the timer starts)
- All Top 5 times from 1/7/25 and onward in ANY category must have the "**FStringDebugShowFlagState": "DFIntMaxAltitudePDStickHipHeightPercent**" FFlag enabled in either Bloxstrap or in the Roblox ClientSettings folder.

# Game Rules:

- Modifiers that give negative saferoom XP are **not allowed.**
- You are not allowed to start runs with modifiers, only choose them via Saferooms.
- **Set Seed** runs are **not allowed.**

# **Glitch Rules:**

Glitches are allowed as long as they can be done on console and mobile devices as well as not being able to be done only with an outside software.

*If you have questions about a glitch not listed here, please inform the moderators in the discord server before doing runs with them.*

## **Examples of techniques that are allowed:**

- Matering (when you hide under a lever in a lever room and survive Carnation)
- Trimping

## **Examples of techniques that are not allowed:**

- Tab Glitching (using the tab bar on your computer to freeze the game to dodge a carnation attack, can't be done mobile or console)
- Lag Abusing/Teleporting

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
# **Game Rules Apply Here**

## Any% Timing Rules:

- Time starts the frame the speedrun timer (in-game timer) turns white.
- Time ends as soon as the hatch to the 5th Saferoom is opened. (If available, use the split provided by the game)

categories.name: Damage
categories.rules:
# **Game Rules apply here**

## Damage Run Rules:

- Your goal is to take damage (Slight, Heed) or die (Carnation, Slugfish, etc.) to your chosen entity.
- Time starts when the speedrun timer (in-game timer) turns white and ends the frame you take damage (white flash).
- Modifiers are **not allowed to be used at all.**

categories.name: Saferoom Marathon
categories.rules:
# **Game Rules Apply Here**

## Highest Amount of Saferooms Rules

- Reach the highest amount of saferooms in one run
- You are allowed to take breaks and rest, but beware of the disconnect timer (20 minutes AFK kick)
- 1 saferoom is equated to 1 milisecond
- You must start recording at the beginning of the game, until your run has finished. We will not accept runs where recording starts after Saferoom 0.

categories.name: Start - Saferoom X
categories.rules:
# **Game & Any% Rules apply here**

# Start - Saferoom X RTA Rules

- You must complete all Saferoom until the respective Saferoom's hatch is opened, and the split is created.
- You are allowed to submit runs that weren't explicitly for your respective Saferoom.
- Modifiers are **not allowed to be used.**
